## Vocabulary

- **self**: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions (19/2)

## How it works

- [statement] Single-document writes are atomic. Use a multi-document transaction when several document writes must be applied or discarded together. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://laravel-news.com/mongodb-transactions-in-laravel

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use `DB::table()` to select a MongoDB collection, chain constraints, and finish with `get()` or `first()`. Select a named MongoDB connection with `DB::connection()` when MongoDB is not the default connection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Configure attribute conversions with `$casts`; the documented model example casts a BSON date field to Laravel `datetime`. Allow-list mass-assignable fields with `$fillable`, or exclude fields with `$guarded`. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Issue #2720 reports that Laravel MongoDB 4.1 raised `Transaction already in progress` when `firstOrCreate()` attempted creation inside an existing transaction. A maintainer attributed the error to an attempted nested transaction and described replacing that implementation with an atomic operation. This is historical issue evidence, not verification of current installed behavior. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb/issues/2720 · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Set query-level options through `options()`. MongoDB recommends using the dedicated query-builder methods for result modifiers such as skip, sort and limit rather than passing these modifiers as options. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Laravel MongoDB extends Laravel’s Eloquent and query-builder APIs to operate on MongoDB data. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb
- [statement] Define a MongoDB Eloquent model by extending `MongoDB\Laravel\Eloquent\Model`. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-laravel-eloquent-style-queries-with-laravel-mongodb/view
- [statement] Models use the snake-case plural class name as the default collection; override `$table` to choose another collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] A MongoDB Eloquent model can use the `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes` trait: deleting marks the document with `deleted_at`, and normal retrieval automatically excludes deleted documents. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-laravel-eloquent-style-queries-with-laravel-mongodb/view
- [statement] The query-builder documentation says results are `stdClass` objects starting in Laravel MongoDB v5.0. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The integration exposes MongoDB `_id` through the `id` alias; query-builder find results present `_id` as `id`, so separate fields with both names are incompatible with that conversion. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md
- [statement] Laravel MongoDB supports explicit transaction control with `DB::beginTransaction()`, `DB::commit()`, and `DB::rollback()` before commit. Rollback reverts writes performed in the transaction. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/database
- [statement] Standalone MongoDB deployments do not support these transactions. The Laravel MongoDB transaction guide prescribes a replica set or sharded cluster, rejects nested transactions with a `RuntimeException`, and disallows parallel operations inside a single transaction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The transaction guide states that Laravel MongoDB does not support `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactions` or `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase`; it suggests `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseMigrations` to reset the database after each test. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Issue #2720 reported `firstOrCreate()` failing inside a transaction on Laravel MongoDB 4.1 with “Transaction already in progress”; the 4.2 release announcement says the issue was fixed by implementing `Model::createOrFirst()` with atomic `findOneAndUpdate`. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb/issues/2720 · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/laravel-mongodb-4-2-released-with-laravel-11-support/271635
- [statement] Laravel MongoDB provides MongoDB-backed Eloquent models and a fluent query builder; Laravel documents the integration as the mongodb/laravel-mongodb package maintained by MongoDB. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md, https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/database
- [statement] Define a MongoDB Eloquent model by extending `MongoDB\Laravel\Eloquent\Model`. The default collection name is the snake case plural of the model class name; override `$table` to choose another collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] MongoDB stores the primary key in `_id`; the Laravel integration exposes it as `$id` on a model and translates query-builder `id` references to `_id`. The model can customize the identifier type with `$keyType`. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The query builder supports filtering nested fields with dotted paths, sorting with `orderBy()`, and skipping results with `skip()`; `whereRaw()` accepts MongoDB Query API filters. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
